StreamBridge Data Deletion Instructions

Last updated: 9 November 2026

StreamBridge respects your privacy and provides a way for users to request deletion of personal data associated with their use of StreamBridge.

How to Request Data Deletion

To request deletion of personal data associated with StreamBridge, please email:

Email: streambridgeapp@outlook.com

Please use the subject: StreamBridge Data Deletion Request

Information to Include

Please include enough information in your request to allow StreamBridge to identify the relevant account or connected platform account.

Do not send passwords, access tokens, app secrets, payment card details or other sensitive authentication information by email.

Facebook and Meta

If you connected StreamBridge with Facebook or another Meta service, you can also remove StreamBridge from the Apps and Websites section of your Facebook account settings.

A request to delete data associated with StreamBridge can also be submitted using the contact method provided above.

Other Connected Platforms

Removing or disconnecting StreamBridge does not automatically delete information held independently by a third-party streaming platform.

For information stored by another platform, please refer to that platform's own privacy and data deletion controls.

Questions

If you have questions about a StreamBridge data deletion request, please contact:

StreamBridge
Email: streambridgeapp@outlook.com

You can also review the StreamBridge Privacy Policy.
